cn_evening_full.description: Run one rolling-window retained-domain update after normal A-share, minute, flow, block-trade and macro same-day releases should be available. Self-healing families are excluded like the natural-day tiers: stk_auction lands via cn_open_auction_capture_0927 + cn_evening_auction_backfill, the margin family via its pre-open jobs + cn_evening_margin_backfill, text via cn_nightly_text_full, the global tier via cn_nightly_global_full, and ann-date disclosure tables via cn_nightly_disclosure_full.

cn_nightly_full_audit.description: Refresh the six data-quality status files (core market, fundamental raw, macro, intraday, event/flow, board trading) every calendar day; event/flow quality uses the latest-publishing next-morning margin boundary for the whole domain. The window end is a natural day because the global tier and the ann-date disclosure tables land every calendar evening: weekend-written rows must be formally audited before Monday's open, not consumed unaudited. Trading-day-bound domains clamp their expectation windows to the last open day internally, so weekend runs re-verify them without false findings. Text is natural-day data and is audited by cn_nightly_text_audit instead.

cn_nightly_text_full.description: Land the text-evidence tier every calendar evening. Text publishes on weekends and holidays, so its window is natural-day (no end_date_mode) and never resolves to an unchanged range: the job runs on Saturdays and Sundays like any other day. Same rolling window and forced refresh the evening update used to apply to this tier, so late vendor corrections in the trailing month are still picked up.

cn_evening_margin_backfill.description: Trading-evening self-healing pass over the margin family: a non-forced 90-day window re-attempts exactly the missing and exchange-incomplete partitions the pre-open chain could not complete (the completeness skip-check re-tries committed partial days until the vendor backfills; observed BSE lag on margin_secs has reached about seven weeks). Same guards as the pre-open jobs; --zero-rows-not-ready keeps a still-unpublished day a retry, not a failure. Cannot recover the same day's pre-open decision inputs; the 02:30 full audit re-audits the event domain after it.

cn_evening_auction_backfill.description: Trading-evening self-heal for stk_auction, the same shape as the margin one: re-read the latest open day for late source corrections and give any missing earlier day in the 90-day window a validated capture attempt (same completeness validation as the pre-open capture). Visibility is the official 09:29 constant regardless of landing time. Invalid or unchanged results never replace existing partitions and never fail the job; remaining gaps escalate through the nightly audit's missing-partition error.

cn_nightly_disclosure_full.description: Land the ann-date disclosure tables (holder counts/trades, top-10 holders, repurchases) every calendar evening. Roughly one row in ten carries a weekend announcement date, and their announcement TEXT already lands the same weekend via the text job; the structured tables must not wait for the next trading evening. Natural-day window (no end_date_mode); the evening update no longer covers these datasets.

cn_nightly_global_full.description: Land the global tier (overseas indices, FX, US treasury rates, economic calendar) every calendar evening. These sources publish through A-share holidays: with the trading-day evening job alone, the first post-holiday session opened on global data up to seven overseas sessions stale (measured National Day 2025). Natural-day window (no end_date_mode); the evening update passes --no-include-global.

cn_nightly_text_audit.description: Refresh text_evidence_status.json every calendar day over the natural-day window the text job has landed. Sole producer of that status file: the trading-day full audit cannot cover a domain whose partitions appear on days it never runs.

cn_weekly_deep_audit.description: Saturday deep cross-check of local history against the vendor: a large deterministic sample of trade-date partitions across the daily, board and flat event tiers is re-fetched and diffed with the same sentinel machinery and ledger as the nightly job. Value recalculation on computed feeds stays a ledgered warning; a massive STRUCTURAL rewrite (at least five probed dates whose keys shrink or grow disproportionately, a quarter or more of the checked dates) escalates the dataset to error. Excluded as not like-for-like probeable: stk_auction (validated capture path), kpl_concept_cons and stk_surv (probe universe differs from the written one), dc_member and block_trade (duplicate business keys defeat the diff).

cn_daily_revision_sentinel.description: Sample historical daily trade-date partitions, compare TuShare source responses with local raw files without overwriting raw data, and append revision events when differences are found. Sample size and datasets come from revision_monitor.sentinel_* (single source).

cn_nightly_pit_event_build.description: Rebuild and audit ALL PIT-ready financial event availability partitions (default_start_date..end). The build reads the whole raw history anyway; full-window replacement keeps every month's provenance aligned with the living raw lake, and the audited range always covers what snapshots can load (the snapshot gateway verifies this).

cn_preopen_board_backfill_0850.description: Pre-open targeted refresh for previous-day board-trading sources that publish after the prior evening window, especially kpl_list next-day 08:30 data.

cn_preopen_text_backfill_0855.description: Pre-open short text refresh over the trailing natural days including today: lands same-morning news before the open, matching the 08:55 Timeview text boundary. cctv_news airs in the evening, so its same-day morning fetch is legitimately empty; the evening full text refresh force-overwrites it with the real transcript.

cn_preopen_margin_backfill_0905.description: Pre-open targeted first attempt for previous-day margin data. Keep it light so downstream audit, snapshot freeze, and Agent decisions can finish before 09:25.

cn_preopen_margin_secs_backfill_0903.description: Pre-open first attempt for same-day financing/margin eligibility before Agent decisions.

cn_preopen_margin_retry_0915.description: Pre-open targeted retry for previous-day margin data. It uses a distinct job name so it still runs if the 09:05 source response was empty but returned successfully.

cn_preopen_margin_secs_retry_0913.description: Pre-open retry for same-day financing/margin eligibility before Agent decisions.

cn_preopen_event_flow_audit_0920.description: Re-audit the WHOLE event/flow domain after the pre-open backfills (margin freshness is the critical part) so 09:25 gates read a status that postdates the pre-open mutations. Deliberately full-domain: narrowing --datasets would write a status whose scope no reader validates, silently claiming domain health from a margin-only scan. ~3 min, finishes before 09:25.

cn_open_auction_capture_0927.description: Poll the same-day stk_auction endpoint until the full-market result is stable, then atomically publish its first observed availability.

cn_weekly_reference_deep.description: Weekly deep refresh of slow-moving per-code reference sweeps (namechange full per-code loop, ths_index membership) moved off the nightly critical path; ~57 min of per-code calls once a week instead of nightly.

cn_weekly_fundamental_deep.description: Weekly 90-day fundamental/dividend sweep for late corrections; the nightly job keeps a 10-day window (announcing codes still get ~10 nightly passes).

manual_macro_coverage_repair.description: Manual (not scheduled): no-force full-window macro-tier re-request. Already-covered partitions skip via coverage sidecars; only genuine gaps download and merge. Run after a coverage incident, optionally with --start-date/--end-date.

manual_global_coverage_repair.description: Manual (not scheduled): no-force full-window global-tier re-request. Already-covered partitions skip via coverage sidecars; only genuine gaps download and merge. Run after a coverage incident, optionally with --start-date/--end-date.

manual_reference_coverage_repair.description: Manual (not scheduled): no-force full-window reference-tier re-request. Existing catalogs and covered partitions skip (no force keys set); index_weight per-year partitions download only genuine coverage gaps via sidecars. Run after a coverage incident, optionally with --start-date/--end-date.

manual_industry_membership_repair.description: Manual (not scheduled): forced re-pull of the Shenwan classification and membership family (index_classify both vintages, index_member_all with is_new=Y/N, frozen SW2014 index_member history). Run after a membership content defect or a vendor backfill revision.

manual_fundamental_statements_repair.description: Manual (not scheduled): forced re-pull of the three financial statements (income_vip/balancesheet_vip/cashflow_vip) over --start-date/--end-date. Repairs vendor per-call cap truncation eras (a capped short page silently ends pagination); follow with the PIT event rebuild and the fundamental audit.

manual_fundamental_restatement_repair.description: Manual (not scheduled): forced full re-pull of fina_mainbz_vip after accepting a vendor segment restatement. Follow the shrink-guard runbook first (verify the restatement at the source, then delete the frozen ts_code partitions); with the partitions gone the guard cannot block the fresh write. Follow with the fundamental audit.

manual_event_caps_repair.description: Manual (not scheduled): forced re-pull of stk_surv/pledge_detail/new_share over --start-date/--end-date. Repairs the measured per-call cap truncation and restamps rows under the current availability rules.

manual_commit_identity_migration.description: Manual (not scheduled): migrate legacy Parquet/sidecar pairs to the UUID footer identity and footer row-count commit protocol. Idempotent: already-valid pairs are skipped, so an interrupted run is finished by re-running it.
